org.eclipse.fennec.model.atlas.rest.clie._comment: Read side. Deliberately the SAME variable ModelAtlasPublisher~publisher reads for its own base.uri: a deployment reads the EPackages of, and publishes back to, one atlas, so one value configures both. The default is where model.atlas's docker-compose-jena.yml puts a local container, which keeps a local run working with nothing set. Note the scopes below stay literal - the overlay exists to name the jena scope, and the publishing scope is a separate decision (MODEL_ATLAS_PUBLISHING_SCOPE).
